questions.q: Where is the Piva Nature Park located?
questions.e: In the video: "Na svega 109 km od Podgorice i oko 380 km od Beograda nalazi se" — just 109 km from Podgorica and about 380 km from Belgrade is located...

questions.q: What is the owner of the ethno-village called?
questions.e: In the video: "dočekao nas je srdačni domaćin, gospodin Novica" — we were welcomed by the warm host, Mr. Novica.

questions.q: What started 30 years ago?
o: His father built a small village tavern
questions.e: In the video: "moj pokojni otac je sagradio jednu malu seosku kafanu ovde na ovoj lokaciji" — my late father built a small village tavern here at this location.

questions.q: When did the idea of an ethno-village come about?
questions.e: In the video: "Mi smo negdje 2007. došli na ideju da pravimo etno-selo" — around 2007 we came up with the idea of building an ethno-village.

questions.q: How many cottages are currently in operation?
questions.e: In the video: "Sad trenutno je 11 kućica u funkciji" — right now 11 cottages are in operation.

questions.q: Who are the first guests of the season?
questions.e: In the video: "Prvi gosti su bajkeri i biciklisti" — the first guests are bikers and cyclists.

questions.q: What share of guests are foreigners?
questions.e: In the video: "osim te 2020. i dijelom 21., 95% strani gosti" — except for 2020 and partly 2021, 95% are foreign guests.

questions.q: What, in the host's view, is the main secret of successful rural tourism?
questions.e: In the video: "ključni model je porodični biznis. Kod nas je uključena kompletna porodica" — the key model is a family business. In our case the entire family is involved.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Pravi *dragulj* Crne Gore, Park prirode Piva.
questions.e: Dragulj — a gemstone, a jewel.

questions.q: Naš *vodič* Petar.
questions.e: Vodič — a guide, a guidebook; voditi — to lead.

questions.q: Imao sam dobru ideju, ali podigao sam 10.000 *kredita*.
questions.e: Kredit — a loan; podići kredit — to take out a loan.

questions.q: Prvih pet bungalova su *dotrajali*.
questions.e: Dotrajati — to wear out, to fall into disrepair.

questions.q: Kada pročitate *recenzije*, uočićete da se mnogi žale.
questions.e: Recenzija — a review.

questions.q: Sjajni su predjeli za *planinarenje*.
questions.e: Planinarenje — mountain hiking; planina — a mountain.

questions.q: Kod nas je uključena supruga, dva sina i *snaha*.
questions.e: Snaha — a daughter-in-law (a son's wife).

questions.q: Mi smo prošlu sezonu bili skoro maksimalno *popunjeni*.
questions.e: Popunjen — filled; popunjenost — occupancy.

questions.q: Na svega 109 km od ___.
questions.e: Od ("from") requires the genitive case: od Podgorice.

questions.q: Uputili smo se do ___.
questions.e: Do ("to, up to") requires the genitive case: do etno-sela.

questions.q: Sa lijepim pogledom na Pivsko ___.
questions.e: Pogled na + accusative case; for neuter nouns it coincides with the nominative: jezero.

questions.q: Došli smo na ___ da pravimo etno-selo.
questions.e: Doći na ideju — accusative case: na ideju.

questions.q: Mi imamo 11 smještajnih ___.
questions.e: After the number 11 the genitive plural is used: objekata.

questions.q: Radimo sve od prirodnih ___.
questions.e: Od ("out of") requires the genitive case: od prirodnih materijala.

questions.q: Rafting na ___ mi organizujemo sa partnerima.
questions.e: Na in answer to "where?" — locative case: na Tari.

questions.q: U porodičnom biznisu rade supruga, dva ___, snaha i unučad.
questions.e: After dva the genitive singular is used: dva sina.
